title: forge build --out <path>: copy the built artifact to a user-named path so a binary runs standalone (./nano), no /tmp path / wrapper script needed

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Add --out <PATH> / -o <PATH> to forge build. After build_file's invoke_rustc produces the stable /tmp artifact, a new place_artifact in build.rs copies it to the user-named <PATH> (std::fs::copy overwrites; chmod +x on unix so ./<PATH> runs directly) and reports <PATH> as BuildManifest::artifact; None keeps the existing /tmp path. build_file gains an out: Option<&Path> param; cli.rs parses --out/-o (separate value token, missing-value Usage error, short flag reachable via starts_with('-')) into Command::Build.out and threads it through run_build. Bad path -> structured ForgeError::Io, never a panic. Verification/lowering untouched (byte-identical artifact). Design doc gets REQ-7 + AC-8. Tests: build_conformance out_places_runnable_binary + out_bad_path_is_structured_error, cli parses_build_out_flag.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (5cda1db). forge build --out/-o <path> copies the artifact to a named path -> a standalone ./binary, no /tmp-path / wrapper script. Critic (the #127+#128 audit) verified --out is VERIFICATION-NEUTRAL: the artifact is byte-IDENTICAL with/without --out (cmp equal), the cert/level/fx unchanged (--out only copies), a bad path -> structured ForgeError (no panic), without --out the /tmp path is unchanged. The one residual it found was #130 (a #127 byteview-collision residual, since fixed + critic-clean). The editor now runs standalone: forge build editor.th --entry run --no-sandbox --out ./nano && ./nano. 675 tests.
